resources.string: DBS7 Ultra Max — Root & Remote ADB
Dangbei DBOS 14 (MT5877) — factory HAL root vector

⚠ Device-specific tool. Targets Dangbei DBOS projectors with the vendor.mediatek.tv.mtktvfactory.IMtkTvFApiSystem HAL. Requires \"Wireless debugging / USB debugging\" already enabled to install this app. Steps: Plant → Restart → Enable ADB.
